messages:
mika: Free L-shaped corner desk + potted monstera plant. Moving out of SF HQ Friday so need it gone by EOD. Pickup from loading bay 2. Pics: http://img.example.com/desk.jpg
jon: size? weight? can pick up earlier maybe Thu evening?
mika: it's 150x120cm (legs at 75cm). fairly solid MDF, heavy. needs two people. includes cable tray and a few zip ties. :seedling:
laura: I'll take the plant if no one else wants it, won't fit my tiny apartment though :grimacing:
zoe: If jon can't, I can bring my van Sat morning, happy to help move
remy: happy to help carry either way, free after 5pm weekdays
mika: @jon you first dibs if you confirm by 4pm today, otherwise @zoe takes Saturday. I can leave it in the loading bay and leave a note on the desk
jon: confirming — I can do Thu 6pm. Will bring a friend to help. DM me the loading bay code?
ops-bot: Reminder: loading bay access must be scheduled via #facilities-bookings. See https://redwood.internal/facilities/bookings
mika: booked via facilities now, link shows slot Thu 6-7pm. I'll leave the desk covered and a small label with your name, jon. Thanks all :tada:
jon: awesome, see you Thu!
laura: plant's mine if jon doesn't want it, but will bring a small pot :relieved:
mika: Desk + plant reserved for jon & zoe assist — updating thread. If plans change ping me here.
jon: picked up — everything went smoothly. Thanks @mika and @remy for the help :thumbsup:
mika: glad it went well, plant survived the ride :seedling: gone. Thanks all :)
